newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss January inflation steady at 0.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss January inflation steady at 0.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Swiss consumer prices rose 0.3 percent in January from the previous month for a year-on-year inflation rate of 0.8 percent, the Federal Statistics Office said.
Monthly CPI index change +0.3 pct +0.1 pct +0.3 pct
The Statistics Office said the strongest increase was in the foodstuffs, beverages and tobacco goods, which gained 1.1 percent. Much of this was tied to seasonal price increases in vegetables.
There were also price gains in transportation and communication, health care, as well as rent and energy.

Prices of domesmtic goods rose 0.3 percent in January, and prices of imported goods rose 0.6 percent. On a year-on-year basis, domestic goods prices rose 0.7 percent and imported goods prices rose 1.2 percent. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
